single_pass_4pos_area_estimate.method: ESTIMATE, not built. One weight word applied to 4 positions in the same cycle needs 4 products and 4 accumulators a lane (and 4 result trees), i.e. the matvec datapath x4; the alternative of 4x ROM read width multiplies the code-ROM macro area
single_pass_4pos_area_estimate.verdict: x4 MACs adds ~103-165 mm2 (2.2-3.6x the 46 mm2 margin); a 2-position single pass adds ~34-55 mm2 (about the whole margin); 4x ROM read width adds ~1,350 mm2. A true single-pass 4-position verify does not fit the reticle; at most a 2-position pass fits, and it removes only the weight re-stream share (<= 2,144 cycles a layer measured bound).
